there was anoither one about sometimes fields not persisting through template's refreshing if the template stayed the same (except weights) due to the order in which t-plan-service sends over the template data when they rebuild the template on their end. the hashcode we use is depoendent on ordering, so if they send the entries over in a different order, then it doesn't match and we don't persist the field. so we simply sort the entries before computing the hash code (but we **don't** store the sorted one, as t-plan for some reason expects it in the exacvt same order they sent it when we submit the plan)

there were some others also, such as if we submit a quick t-plan with no/incomplete reference prices,m they are sent as empty strings, and the tube JSON decoder has a fit and throws ugly error messages, so now FE sends over the fields as `null` if they don't have prices and the BE enforces that the prices are supplied only if the template contains a price offset field (otherwise we allow missing reference prices)

the price fields on a quick t-plan template inside an FX ticket aren't being populated if the ccy pair is illiquid (obvioysly), but the fields aren't being flagged as violated as we don't fully check the template initially (as we expect FE to send over TOB prices, but in thise case, there are no prices to send over)
so yesterday I made it so we *alwqays* validate initially... but that makes the price fields pulse red as they are marked invalid. the errors are cleared when FE sends the prices but still this is visually annoying.
so now FE is sending over an `is_pricing` parameter and we only fully validate if `!is_pricing` which will stop the pulsing behaviour
